name: AR_UPD_BANK_ACCOUNTS
description: AR_UPD_BANK_ACCOUNTS contains customer bank account interface data entered into a simplified customer spreadsheet template for upload.

columns.name: BANKACCT_UPLOAD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a customer upload record.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a customer import batch process.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system identifier for the customer account.

columns.name: ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the source system used to load data into the TCA registry.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account site.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the customer account.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the party site. This number indicates unique reference of the addresses associated to a party.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Country code from the TERRITORY_CODE column in the FND_TERRITORY table. For example, US for United State of America or DE for Germany.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer bank. The combination of BANK_NAME and BRANCH_NAME must be unique. Do not use if the bank account already exists.

columns.name: BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank number associated with the customer bank account. Must be unique. Do not use if the bank account already exists.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Name of the bank where the account for the customer was opened.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Customer bank account name. This is a mandatory field. Use the Manage Bank Accounts task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_PRIMARY_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary bank account for the customer. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Activation date of the customer bank account. The customer can be assigned to more than one bank account as long as there is no overlapping date range.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency of the customer bank account. Use the Manage Currencies task to identify valid values. Use the three character ISO code, such as USD for the US dollar.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the customer bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_CHECK_DIGITS
columns.description: One or more digits used to validate a bank account number. This is a free text field that is not validated.

columns.name: BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank branch of the customer bank. The combination of BANK_NAME and BRANCH_NAME must be unique. Do not use if the bank account already exists. Mandatory if bank account is not defined.

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Branch number or branch routing number associated with the customer bank account. Must be unique. Do not use if the bank account already exists.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_EFT_USER_NUMBER
columns.description: Electronic fund transfer user number of the customer bank branch. This is a free text field that is not validated.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the parent job that processes this record.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the upload status of this record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
